# Vendored files

Copied in unchanged so the game needs no build step and loads nothing from other sites.

| File | What it is | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `three.module.min.js` | three.js r169, the 3D library | npm package `three@0.169.0`, `build/three.module.min.js` | MIT (header in the file) |
| `fonts/pixelify-sans-*.woff2` | Pixelify Sans, the body typeface | Google Fonts | SIL OFL 1.1, `fonts/OFL-PixelifySans.txt` |
| `fonts/silkscreen-latin.woff2` | Silkscreen, the display typeface | Google Fonts | SIL OFL 1.1, `fonts/OFL-Silkscreen.txt` |
